   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  October 14, 2024

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 6:02 p.m. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Ang and
Commissioner Beacham. Commissioner Sanchez was absent. Also present was Rosalee Santa Ana,
Senior Management Analyst, Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III and Jocelyn Hernandez,
Communications Specialist.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Chair Leon made the motion and Commissioner Beacham seconded to approve the minutes for
September 9, 2024. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

First Responder’s Appreciation Luncheon

Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners for feedback on the event. Commissioners would like to
continue with the decorated placemats next year, possibly asking for older grades to decorate. Mrs.
Ocegueda also confirmed next year’s event date as Wednesday, October 1, 2025.

Home and Business Décor Contest

Mrs. Ocegueda asked the Commission what timeline they wanted to take in nominations and to judge.
Commissioners would like to start taking submissions on November 17th and the deadline on December
13th. Commissioners will be out judging on December 20th. Commissioners asked Mrs. Ocegueda to
reach out to the Chamber of Commerce to help promote the contest with businesses. Mrs. Ocegueda
stated she will have the door hangers for Commissioners to help promote the contest. Commissioners
asked Mrs. Ocegueda if she can obtain a booth at the Tree Lighting Ceremony on December 7th so
Commissioners can talk to residents and get feedback on their desires for future events.

Business Spotlight

Ms. Santa Ana showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the September Chicken Spots edition video
to Commissioners. Mrs. Ocegueda stated that staff will be out later in the week to start filming the
October edition of the Business Spotlight. Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners if the wording on the
certificate is ok to read “Best Celebration Spots” and include Norwalk’s own Senior Center as it was
voted on and came in 2nd place. The Commission ok’d the wording on the certificate and keeping the
Senior Center in the Top 3.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Ms. Santa Ana provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s
overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
October 14, 2024

STAFF COMMENTS:

Ms. Santa Ana thanked Commissioners for their support and participation at the First Responders
Luncheon. Ms. Santa Ana stated that First Responders and Public Safety were appreciative of the
event and excited for the raffle.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Vice Chair Ang thanked Mrs. Ocegueda for her hard work in putting together the First Responders
Luncheon. Vice Chair Ang mentioned there were issues with the script for the Arturo Sanchez, Sr.
Halloween Parade. Ms. Santa Ana will pass on the issues Vice Chair Ang had to the appropriate
channels. Vice Chair Ang attended the St. Linus Fiesta, commented that they had a great turn out, and
would be interested in seeing the Commissions presence at non-city events. Chair Leon commented
that she enjoyed her time helping at the announcer booth at the Halloween Parade and thought that
the contract engineer Cody was a great help to them.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:38 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
